howItWorks.lead: Neither WhatsApp groups nor foreign platforms guarantee the right match at the right price — TERANGA does it in one place.

steps.title: Find the right developer
steps.text: Filter by country, skill and rating. Every profile shows a portfolio of real projects delivered across francophone West Africa.

steps.title: Post your brief
steps.text: Structured brief: site type, budget in FCFA, delivery deadline. 1 Token, no subscription.

steps.title: Contact unlocks with 1 Token
steps.text: The interested developer pays 1 Token to write to you. Your private conversation opens — no more cold applications.

steps.title: Talk it out directly
steps.text: Quotes, details, schedule: everything goes through the internal messaging. Your WhatsApp stays private until you agree.

steps.title: Choose and pay with no commission
steps.text: You deal together, via Wave, Orange Money or Max It. TERANGA takes nothing from your project.

pricing.lead: No subscription, no hidden fees. TERANGA only earns money when you use a Token.

faqs.a: TERANGA LABS is the marketplace of web projects for francophone West Africa: you post your website brief for 1 Token, and the interested developer unlocks your contact with 1 Token. Then you deal directly — no commission.

faqs.q: How much does a Token cost?
faqs.a: {token}. Registration is free: you order your Tokens online (bank card or mobile money), then post your brief or unlock a contact.

faqs.q: Is there a commission on projects?
faqs.a: No. TERANGA LABS takes no commission on projects: the developer and the client deal together, with no middleman. Against 15 to 20 % taken elsewhere, here you keep 100 % of your budget.
Yes. Your number never appears on briefs or in search results: exchanges go through the internal messaging, and you alone decide when to share your contact.
Across the 9 countries of francophone West Africa: Senegal, Ivory Coast, Mali, Burkina Faso, Niger, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Benin and Togo. Prices are shown in FCFA.
